reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-sized sachet that tears open with one hand: I live out of a tote and forget bottles at my partner's place, so one sachet in the bag fixes that. I would try the single bisglycinate box for sleep before paying for anything fancier.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps? Magnesium is hit or miss for me, and $29.99 is a lot to spend on a month that might do nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller trial pack or a money-back guarantee if I feel nothing after a few weeks.
